### Life Is Too Brief to Waste: Learning to Number Our Days
Author: Jon Bloom
Site: Desiring God
URL: https://www.desiringgod.org/articles/life-is-too-brief-to-waste
Passage: Psalm 90:12
Points:
- Human life speeds by quickly, and even a long life is brief compared to God's eternal nature.
- Coming to terms with how few days we are given keeps us from squandering our fleeting lives.
- God does not equate shortness of time with insignificance; brief moments can carry profound, lasting weight.
- Gaining a heart of wisdom means understanding that ordinary daily choices have eternal significance before Christ.

### A Prayer for the Best Use of Our Time - Your Daily Prayer - February 6
Author: Ashley Moore
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/your-daily-prayer/a-prayer-for-the-best-use-of-our-time.html
Passage: Psalm 90:12
Points:
- Human beings face real limitations in capacity and time when balancing aspirations with daily responsibilities.
- Saying yes to what truly matters inevitably requires learning to say no to lesser or exhausting obligations.
- Moses prayed for God to teach us to number our days so we can navigate life's brevity with heavenly wisdom.
- Discerning the best use of our time involves asking whether our choices hold eternal significance and honor God.

### A Prayer to Use Your Time Wisely - Your Daily Prayer - July 25
Author: Emily Rose Massey
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/your-daily-prayer/a-prayer-to-use-your-time-wisely.html
Passage: Psalm 90:12
Points:
- God exists outside of time, but He established earthly time with divine intention for human life.
- Numbering our days requires recognizing God's sovereign control over the exact span of our lives.
- Wasting time on temporal distractions and laziness diminishes our spiritual fruitfulness for God's kingdom.
- Believers should view each day as a gift to prioritize discipleship and glorify God.

### Numbering Our Days: The Value of Today - Your Daily Bible Verse - December 28
Author: Greg Laurie
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/your-daily-bible-verse/numbering-our-days-the-value-of-today-bible-study-minute-december-31-2018.html
Passage: Psalm 90:12
Points:
- Life passes far more quickly than we realize, making it essential to seize the opportunities before us today.
- Numbering our days involves actively applying our hearts to godly wisdom rather than drifting through life.
- Like the servants in Jesus's parable of the talents, Christians are called to invest their lives for their Master.
- God does not demand talents we lack, but expects faithful effort with what He has entrusted to us.
